english.note: Use 等於 as the all-purpose verb when something has the same value or amounts to the same consequence.

exampleSentences.english: Five kilograms equal five thousand grams.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ng5 gung1 gan1 dang2 jyu1 ng5 cin1 hak1

english.note: Use 等於 when one thing is exactly equivalent to or has the same value as another.

exampleSentences.english: Ten ten-dollar bills correspond to one hundred dollars.
exampleSentences.traditional: 十張十蚊紙等於一百蚊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: sap6 zoeng1 sap6 man1 zi2 dang2 jyu1 jat1 baak3 man1

english.note: Use this for arithmetic or other statements that one quantity adds up to or amounts to another.

exampleSentences.english: Three plus two make a total of five.
exampleSentences.jyutping: saam1 gaa1 ji6 dang2 jyu1 ng5
